title: Thou Art the Way; to Thee Alone
description: Thou Art the Way; to Thee Alone in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: George Washington Doane wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 94.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Thou art the Way; to Thee a-lone From sin and death we flee; And he who would the Fa-ther seek, Must seek Him, Lord, by Thee.

lines: Thou art the Way; to Thee alone
From sin and death we flee;
And he who would the Father seek,
Must seek Him, Lord, by Thee.
Thou art the Truth; Thy Word alone
Thou only canst inform the mind
Thou art the Life; the rending tomb
And those who put their trust in Thee
Nor death nor hell shall harm.
Thou art the Way, the Truth, the Life;
Grant us that Way to know,
That Truth to keep, that Life to win,

licence: Public domain: George Washington Doane died in 1859.
credits: Words by George Washington Doane (1799–1859), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
